images.prompt:
Screen: ANSWERS ONLY GOD CAN GIVE. Title 'Answers Only God Can Give', one-line subtitle 'The Lord sets the record straight concerning topics, doctrines and traditions'. A search field 'Search the topics'. Section 'The Ten Commandments' as a neat 2-column grid of ten compact tiles with a roman numeral and a short name: I No other gods, II No idols, III His name in vain, IV The Sabbath, V Honor parents, VI Do not murder, VII No adultery, VIII Do not steal, IX No false witness, X Do not covet. Section 'Browse by subject · 102 topics' with rows: 'The Lord & His Messiah · 13 topics', 'His Word & His Prophets · 10 topics', 'Sin, Repentance & Salvation · 8 topics', 'Walking With God · 14 topics', 'The End of This Age · 17 topics'.
Render in the DARK theme exactly like Image 1.
Render as a crisp, flat, full-bleed Android phone screen UI mockup, front view, portrait orientation, no hands, no desk, no perspective, no device photo; very thin rounded phone outline at most. Real, legible, correctly spelled text. Professional product-design quality (Apple Design Award / Material Design showcase level). Calm, reverent, uncluttered; strong typographic hierarchy; generous whitespace; consistent 8-pt spacing; touch targets at least 48 dp; WCAG AA contrast. No emoji, no stock photos, no people, no crosses or church clip-art, no logos.
TEXT FIDELITY (strict): use ONLY the exact wording supplied in this spec for any scripture, letter, lyric or dedication text. Wherever the layout needs more running text than supplied, render it as soft grey placeholder lines (greeked bars), never as readable sentences. Never write new sentences attributed to God, the Bible, the letters or the songs. UI labels may be written freely.
